UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated player profile storing preferred nickname and lifetime match statistics.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

nickname.description: Player's preferred display name (1 to 30 characters).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

GameRoom.title: Game Room
GameRoom.description: Real-time Guess the Personality multiplayer party room synced across devices.

roomCode.description: Short 6-character uppercase alphanumeric room code matching the document ID.

hostId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host (immutable after creation).

hostName.description: Display nickname of the room host (1 to 30 characters).

deckIds.description: Ordered subset of finalized personality IDs (1 to 100 entries, each integer 1..100). Card #1 maps to deckIds[0], Card #N maps to deckIds[N-1].

deckFinalized.description: True once the host locks the personality subset for player number selection.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of up to 20 Firebase Auth UIDs participating in the room.

players.description: Map keyed by player UID storing nickname, selectedCardNumber (0..N), cardVisible, roundQuestions (0..5), totalQuestions (0..15), guessCompleted, guessedCorrectly, round1Score, round2Score, round3Score, and totalScore.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user profile and lifetime stats scoped strictly to the authenticated owner.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Real-time party game rooms addressable by short room code, with action-gated host and member updates.
